parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

SENTRIX="{{ $json.SentrixBarcode || $json.sentrix_id }}"
IDAT_DIR="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/$SENTRIX"

QC_TXT=$(find "$IDAT_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name "*.txt" -o -name "*.log" \) | head -1 || true)

if [ -z "$QC_TXT" ]; then
  echo ""
  exit 0
fi

cat "$QC_TXT"
BASH_SCRIPT

parameters.query:
WITH input_json AS (
    SELECT
        $qc$ {{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_control_metrics) }} $qc$::jsonb AS qc
),
params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'::text AS sentrix_id,
        '{{ $json.position }}'::text AS position
),
target_idat AS (
    SELECT
        i.uniqueref AS idat_ref,
        s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
        s.sentrix_id,
        i.position
    FROM idats i
    JOIN scans s
      ON s.uniqueref = i.scan_ref
    JOIN params p
      ON p.sentrix_id = s.sentrix_id
     AND p.position = i.position
),
qc_kv AS (
    SELECT
        kv.key AS qc_key,
        kv.value AS qc_value
    FROM input_json ij
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(ij.qc) AS kv(key, value)
),
metric_values AS (
    SELECT
        ti.idat_ref,
        c.uniqueref AS measurement_concept_ref,
        NULLIF(q.qc_value, '')::numeric AS value_as_number
    FROM qc_kv q
    CROSS JOIN target_idat ti
    JOIN concepts c
      ON c.concept_name = q.qc_key
     AND c.vocabulary_id = 'Illumina'
    WHERE q.qc_key NOT IN (
        'DatasetLabel',
        'Row',
        'Column',
        'ImagingDate',
        'SampleId',
        'SampleName',
        'SamplePlate',
        'SampleWell',
        'ScannerId',
        'ScannerVersion',
        'SentrixBarcode',
        'SentrixPosition',
        'SampleFolderPath',
        'Functional QC Status',
        'Control QC Flag Codes',
        'SexEstimate',
        '_debug_text_length',
        '_debug_reg_positions_count',
        '_debug_first_pos_value',
        'qc_stdout',
        'sentrix_id',
        'qc_xlsx',
        'qc_xlsx_server'
    )
      AND q.qc_value IS NOT NULL
      AND q.qc_value <> ''
      AND q.qc_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO measurement_idats (
        idat_ref,
        measurement_concept_ref,
        value_as_number
    )
    SELECT
        idat_ref,
        measurement_concept_ref,
        value_as_number
    FROM metric_values
    ON CONFLICT (idat_ref, measurement_concept_ref)
    DO UPDATE SET
        value_as_number = EXCLUDED.value_as_number
    RETURNING uniqueref
)
SELECT
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    ti.scan_ref,
    ti.idat_ref,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metric_values) AS metric_value_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted) AS upserted_measurement_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN target_idat ti ON TRUE;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'::text AS sentrix_id,
        '{{ $json.position }}'::text AS position,
        '{{ $json.sex_estimate }}'::text AS sex_estimate,
        '{{ $json.gtc_file_path }}'::text AS gtc_file_path,

        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.bpm'::text AS bpm_name,
        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.csv'::text AS csv_name,
        '2003.egt'::text AS egt_name
),
scan_ref AS (
    SELECT
        s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
        s.sentrix_id
    FROM scans s
    JOIN params p
      ON s.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
),
concept_refs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.bpm_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS bpm_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.csv_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS csv_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.egt_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS egt_concept_ref
    FROM concepts c
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE c.concept_name IN (p.bpm_name, p.csv_name, p.egt_name)
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE idats i
    SET
        gtc_file_path = p.gtc_file_path,
        estimated_gender = NULLIF(p.sex_estimate, ''),
        manifest_bpm_concept_ref = cr.bpm_concept_ref,
        manifest_csv_concept_ref = cr.csv_concept_ref,
        cluster_file_concept_ref = cr.egt_concept_ref,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM params p
    JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
    CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
    WHERE i.scan_ref = sr.scan_ref
      AND i.position = p.position
      AND cr.bpm_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.csv_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.egt_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING i.uniqueref
)
SELECT
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    p.gtc_file_path,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref,
    COUNT(u.uniqueref) AS updated_idat_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
LEFT JOIN updated u ON TRUE
GROUP BY
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    p.gtc_file_path,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref;

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
TMP_ROOT="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/.tmp_dragena"

if [ -d "$TMP_ROOT" ]; then
  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_deleted\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
else
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_not_found\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
fi
BASH_SCRIPT

=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

SENTRIX="{{ $json.sentrix_id }}"
QC_DIR="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/.tmp_dragena/$SENTRIX/qc_report"

QC_XLSX=$(ls -t "$QC_DIR"/DRAGENArray_QC_table_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)

if [ -z "$QC_XLSX" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_missing\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"qc_dir_server\":\"$QC_DIR\"}"
  exit 1
fi

N8N_QC_XLSX=$(echo "$QC_XLSX" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')

echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_found\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"qc_xlsx\":\"$N8N_QC_XLSX\",\"qc_xlsx_server\":\"$QC_XLSX\"}"
BASH_SCRIPT
